verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Svelte as a framework built around declarative components. Each component has its own reactive local state: `count` is a plain variable, with `$state.raw`, `$derived` and `$effect` for related cases. Component CSS is scoped to the component, which reinforces encapsulation. Community reports confirm it is used for complex apps and that its Context system and stores share state across composed components. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the composition mechanics themselves (props, nesting child components, snippets/slots), plus independent hands-on evidence focused specifically on component composition.
